_note: Shop contact details. Used when the store settings from the API (POS site settings) have no value of their own: the call links, footer and <noscript> text in index.html (phone), every WhatsApp button (whatsapp, international digits) and the Open-in-Maps buttons (mapUrl). appQr: file name of a QR code image placed in public/ (for example "/app-qr.png", linking to the app or PWA install page); empty shows a placeholder in the footer.
